tasks.title: Impact analysis: model, migration path, cache, idempotency
Design schema change, migration and API field
Add max_clicks column and additive migration
Enforce limit in LinkService; bypass cache for limited links
Fix idempotent replay of deleted links (410)

risks.risk: Existing SQLite/Postgres databases lack the new column and would crash
risks.mitigation: Additive, idempotent startup migration for nullable columns; NOT NULL changes refused and left to a reviewed migration

risks.risk: Redirect cache would bypass the click limit
risks.mitigation: Never cache click-limited links; test asserts it

risks.risk: Limit can be exceeded by concurrent requests
risks.mitigation: Documented as approximate; strict mode out of scope

decisions.rationale: Change touches the schema, cache and idempotency paths
